div.p: This case-sensitive code system https://fhir-ig.digitalhealth.gov.ng/CodeSystem/ng-alert-category-cs defines the following codes:

tr.td: A general clinical alert that does not fall into a more specific clinical category.
An alert concerning a known or suspected allergy or intolerance.
An alert concerning medication prescribing, dispensing, administration, duplication, or interaction.
An alert concerning vaccination eligibility, contraindication, due status, administration, or follow-up.
An alert concerning an abnormal, critical, pending, or otherwise significant laboratory result.
An alert concerning infection prevention, isolation, exposure, or transmission risk.
An alert concerning protection, abuse, neglect, exploitation, or another safeguarding risk.
An alert concerning a notifiable condition, outbreak, surveillance event, or public-health action.
An alert concerning an administrative, operational, eligibility, consent, or service-delivery issue.
An alert concerning record completeness, identity, duplication, integrity, or another data-quality issue.
An alert category not represented by another code in this code system.

description.value: Categories used to classify alerts represented using the Nigeria Alert Flag profile.
